messages:
maya: Quick sync — I sketched three hero directions for the pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Need alignment before I hand off to design.
jonathan: nice. can you drop the short rationale for each? makes it easier to A/B later
maya: sure. short versions below 👇
- Hosted API: ‘get started in minutes — predictable throughput, transparent pricing’ (target: PLG devs)
- Dedicated: ‘reserved capacity for stable SLAs & isolation’ (target: platform teams)
- Private: ‘bring inference inside your network with enterprise controls’ (target: regulated customers)
elliot: those read fine. we should avoid repeating "predictable" across two headings. maybe swap wording on hosted to “get going fast with clear performance”
sam: +1 on shorter verbs. also we need a bench narrative paragraph — one blurb that explains perf/cost tradeoffs without deep tech jargon for the hero band
maya: good call. draft bench blurb: “Benchmarked across production workloads: single-digit tail latency on common request types, 2–4x cost reduction via batching & KV caching vs naive serving” — too nerdy?
jonathan: keep the numbers but soften: “benchmarks show lower latency and substantial cost savings; see our webinar for workload-specific results” — link to webinar later
sam: speaking of webinar — webinar plan: February 9th, 11am PT. Agenda: 1) Real-world benchmarks, 2) How to pick Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, 3) Live demo + Q&A
maya: I put a hero CTA matrix in the doc: primary CTA for Hosted = Try API, for Dedicated = Contact sales, for Private = Request trial. Is that ok for the funnel?
elliot: yes but add a lightweight instant option for Dedicated: "Estimate costs" (lead gen without full sales touch)
copybot: Reminder: AB test variants must be in Google Doc before design handoff. See /docs/marketing/hero-ab-tests
jonathan: inbound routing note — we should tag leads from each CTA with source=hero_v1 and mode=hosted|dedicated|private so sales/SDR can route. Example UTMs: ?src=hero_v1&mode=hosted
sam: also capture intent-level param: ?intent=eval or ?intent=production. that lets us route high-intent trial requests faster
maya: design questions for the hero microcopy: do we stack the bench blurb under the heading or in a subtle ribbon? I lean ribbon so it doesn't compete with the CTA
elliot: ribbon is good. also include a subtle link: “view full benchmarks” that opens a modal with images + short tables — avoids long page scrolling
maya: ok I'll update the doc with ribbon mock and modal copy. can someone drop the short webinar blurb for the sign-up modal? needs 40–60 chars
jonathan: "Live: benchmarks, deployment tradeoffs, and a demo — Feb 9" (48 chars)
sam: perfect. I'll make a simple routing mapping for the form posts and share in this thread later
copybot: Heads up — deploy preview for marketing site will spin up when the doc lands in /marketing/hero-v1 branch
maya: thanks — aim to finalize copy by EOD Thursday so design can iterate Fri. tagging @jonathan @elliot @sam for quick reviews
jonathan: I'll review by noon Thu
sam: can do afternoon Thu
elliot: thumbs up
maya: thanks team!"
